_doc: Marksman line (spec #360, ticket MS2 #362). The second archer after Bowmaster: its job entry, its AP row and its bot card scores. Skill definitions are in skills/marksman.json; each Marksman skill ticket (MS5-MS9) appends its own region. Marksman has NO mobility_skill (ruling D1, spec #360): a Marksman owns no skill key and no quick-slot movement cell. playable stays false until MS11 #371; JobTree.default_job() stays 212 (survivor/jobs.json default_job). DataRepo discovers this per-line file automatically (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4).

322._starting_skill: tier C: spec #360: Iron Arrow : Crossbow is the starting active (slot 1) and the first skill a round learns; MS5 #365 moves its definition from skills/bowman.json into skills/marksman.json.
322._skill_pool: tier C: spec #360: the ten hand-picked Marksman actives from the 300/320/321/322 books (all auto-cast). arrow_blow is Bowmaster's shared definition (job 300). Undefined keys stay inert until their tickets define them.
322._weapon_families: tier C: spec #360: crossbows only (WeaponInfo family crossbow, 146xxxx); bows (145xxxx) belong to Bowmaster. Armour and shields drop by the Bowman class bit.
322._creation_weapon: tier A: the Crossbow (Item.wz 1462001, reqJob 4 = the Bowman bit, PAD 29; reqLevel 12 is no longer enforced, #292). Already in the Bowman manifest fragment and drop list.
322._provenance: tier C: spec #360 MS2 #362: data-only until MS11 #371 flips playable; default_job stays 212.

322._ap: tier C: spec #360: the Bowman (300) row copied verbatim (the Bowman gear pattern, no new tuning); explicit so 322 no longer falls back through 321/320/300.

bot._card_scores: tier C: spec #360: the two followers score explicitly (learn 100, rank 74, the numbers the pool default gives every curated skill) because BotInput._base_score only treats projectile / instant / box skills as attacks; the other eight pool skills score as attacks by default.
